recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片顯示細胞量豐富的骨髓顆粒（particle），可見數顆巨核細胞與脂肪空泡；此倍率無法看到巨大顆粒，只能評估細胞密度。
features: Highly cellular marrow particle with abundant hematopoietic cells
A few fat vacuoles within the particle
Individual cytoplasmic granules not resolvable at low power
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a highly cellular particle composed of a mixed hematopoietic population with scattered megakaryocytes and few fat spaces. Cellular detail, including cytoplasmic granules, cannot be assessed at this magnification. The field documents adequate, cellular aspirate material; diagnostic giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome require examination at high power.

ddx.vs: Separated only at high power by normal granule morphology and orderly maturation.
Leukemia shows a monotonous blast population at higher magnification rather than mixed maturing cells.
